reviewContext.userProblem: Reconcile 36 unchecked parent P1 requirements against current source, published work and evidence; close only real remaining P1 gaps.
requiredOutcomes: Classify all 36 original requirements and current clauses with source, evidence, review and ownership in the existing plan ledger.
Repair only demonstrated material gaps on current source and obtain independent test-integrity, Sol adversarial and Astra integration decisions.
Keep V5 Work/CLI/Core and full Swift aggregates FAILED at exit 1 with separate attribution and review dispositions for 21 baseline-matched assertions each.
After acceptance, align P1 designs, plan, progress and index; commit exact reviewed files and non-force push until Draft PR #109 remote tip equals local HEAD.
nonGoals: No repetition of published P1-6d, P1-7b, P1-7a A2-A5 or native receiver work without demonstrated material invalidation.
No archived rielflow or Monja tenant-sharding-d48 edits, other-session/worktree disturbance, main merge, release, speculative redesign or broad rerun without material invalidation.
constraints: Use the immutable user-scope codex-design-and-implement-review-loop package and one serial mutation owner.
Preserve the original 36 boxes and P1-6a through P1-7b published source and receipts; keep all scratch and new evidence under repository-root tmp/.
Source/test edits require an accepted bounded ownership amendment and runtime write-path projection before modification.
Keep unrelated tracked, untracked and staged changes outside exact checkpoint and final commit allowlists.
designDecisionsAndRationale: The §17.11 ledger distinguishes complete, materially open, historical/superseded and externally blocked requirements so prior unchecked process boxes are not treated as unimplemented behavior.
Compare receipt input seals, dependencies, full logs and actual prior review artifacts against current source before reusing evidence.
Run affected commands only after material invalidation; independent reviewers separately decide both failed aggregate attributions on the final tree.
Use one serial p1-dispatch plan because audit, conditional repair, shared status files and publication depend on one ordered reviewed tree.
intentionalTradeoffs: A0 historical per-command environment snapshots are unavailable and must remain an explicit evidence limit.
Baseline-attributed aggregate failures remain FAILED rather than being described as passing or hidden by equal counts.
supportedEdgeCases: Historical/superseded boxes retain original text and link to current replacement requirements; compound rows can split by disposition.
Native retired top-level fields reject presence including false/null before effects while opaque runtimeVariables and task-free workflows remain supported.
Cancellation, reservation/session identity, specialist/event/loop/routine paths and draft PR remote-tip equality remain explicit acceptance targets.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: No new receiver protocol, task GraphQL/UI counterpart, recursive runtimeVariables validation, registry discovery or unrelated formatting/test repair.
No force push, global archive move, new index schema, speculative package digest or lockfile update.

plan.reviewDecision: The single active plan aligns with accepted §17.11, preserves the 36-item inventory, and specifies serial ownership, dependencies, evidence, independent reviews, progress tracking, and publication checks.

acceptanceCriteria: Every original P1-U01 through P1-U36 box and current clause has a classified, source-linked and evidence-backed ledger disposition.
Any material gap receives bounded ownership, current-source repair and affected verification with complete terminal receipts.
Independent test-integrity, Sol adversarial and Astra integration decisions accept final coverage and separately dispose of both FAILED broad aggregates without unresolved high/mid findings.
Serial final status updates preserve unrelated plans; exact reviewed files are committed and pushed non-force with local HEAD, remote tip and Draft PR #109 head equal.
